source_clock: AllrawSRAM writes/reads onwclk, readbeforewritecatalogsemantics; neverconnectrclktoSRAMarray. Registeredencoder, synchronousSRAMread, sourceheldslotpublish, twoGray/epochrailsync stages, registeredconsumerlanding/decode/output.
protection: 39-bitSECDED per32bits overpayload+epoch+sequence; internalbinarypointer/flags/epochs complemented; Graycredit/publish/epochs crossedprotectedpairs; rawoutputholdingregcheckedagainstECCdecodewhilevalid; poisonUE/staleseq/staleepoch, noearlycredit.

macro.claim_boundary: abstract views from a calibrated analytical model on measured ASAP7 bitcells and ASAP7 standard-cell FO4; no transistor layout, no SPICE of the macro, not silicon; ASAP7 is a predictive PDK and nothing here is a foundry N7 number

drain_cap_per_cell_ff.note: bitline junction plus contact load one cell adds; the IHP 130 nm extraction (results/spice/ihp_sg13g2_rom_read_energy) measured 0.50 fF/row and is NOT scaled here

dual_port_cell_area_ratio.note: 8T 1R1W (decoupled read stack) and 8T 2RW (two pass-gate pairs) cells relative to the measured 6T; the ASAP7 run drew only the 6T

gate_cap_per_fin_ff.note: INVx1 input capacitance / its 6 fins (3 n + 3 p), from the calibration liberty

periphery_energy_ff_per_bit.note: switched capacitance of sense amplifier, output latch and IO driver per output bit

periphery_fo4_budget.note: logic depth of the periphery in ASAP7 FO4 delays at each corner

periphery_geometry_um.note: column_fixed is solved so a 512 x 512 SRAM array with mux 4 reproduces the published 7 nm macro efficiency (Yokoyama et al., VLSI 2020); the other entries are assumed

rom_cell_read_current_ua.note: one 1-fin NMOS pull-down (no stack) per programmed NOR-ROM cell at 0.70 V, TT

rom_sense_swing_v.note: single-ended bitline swing against a reference at the sense amplifier

sram_cell_read_current_ua.note: 1-fin pass-gate/pull-down read stack of a 7 nm HD cell at 0.70 V, TT; published 7 nm HD cells report read currents of this order; no ASAP7 SRAM SPICE was run

wordline_layer.note: wordline strap on M2, bitline on M1

fakeram7_256x32.source: ORFS platforms/asap7 lib/NLDM/fakeram7_256x32.lib and lef/fakeram7_256x32.lef in openroad/orfs:latest; FakeRAM2.0 output whose own config says 'VALUES NOT REALISTIC'

n7_hd_6t_bitcell_um2.source: configs/hardware/technology.json nodes.N7.sram_hd_bitcell_um2 (TSMC N7 HD 6T; Jeong et al., IEDM 2016 / Chang et al., ISSCC 2017 256 Mb 7 nm SRAM)

n7_sram_macro_density_mb_mm2.macro: one 512 x 512 cell array (256 kbit), dual-edge driven wordline and bitline
n7_sram_macro_density_mb_mm2.source: Yokoyama et al., 'A 29.2 Mb/mm2 Ultra High Density SRAM Macro using 7nm FinFET Technology with Dual-Edge Driven Wordline/Bitline and Write/Read-Assist Circuit', IEEE Symposium on VLSI Circuits 2020, doi:10.1109/VLSICircuits18222.2020.9162985
